summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package is a stub (described as 'Compatibility shim') published under the `@ecg-internal` scope on the public registry, a shape consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal namespace. Its `main` (index.js) is a no-op Proxy, but both the `postinstall` lifecycle hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and `require()` of the package invoke `beacon.fire()`, which performs a plain-HTTP POST to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The payload includes the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install path (`__dirname`), `process.cwd()`, and a `npm/<node-version>` user-agent string. This fires automatically on `npm install` and again whenever any code imports the package, allowing the operator of 185.158.107.175 to confirm which internal hosts resolved the attacker-published scoped name and to collect host identifiers and filesystem path information from each affected build/developer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
